title: Wildwood
reviewTitle: Handcrafted stop-motion wonder in the Impassable Wilderness
reviewBody: LAIKA's most ambitious fantasy epic to date. Adapting Colin Meloy's novel, the tactile stop-motion artistry brings Portland's enchanted forests to life with breathtaking creature puppetry, menacing bandit factions, and genuine emotional resonance.

title: Control: Resonant
reviewTitle: Brutalist cosmic horror spills into a warped Manhattan
reviewBody: Shifting perspective to Dylan Faden outside the Oldest House expands Remedy's surreal worldbuilding into an open-ended paranormal playground. The fluid aerial traversal, reality-bending telekinesis, and eerie sound design deliver an unforgettable atmosphere.

title: On The Road
author: Jack Kerouac
reviewTitle: Feverish jazz prose, open highways, and restless post-war spirit
reviewBody: A foundational text of the Beat Generation. Kerouac's spontaneous bop prosody captures the ecstatic velocity of cross-country road trips with Sal Paradise and Dean Moriarty, searching for meaning and wild freedom across America.

title: Dopamine Chamber
reviewTitle: Atmospheric darkwave textures, dream pop, and gritty urgent rock
reviewBody: Produced by James Ford, Dopamine Chamber pushes Fontaines D.C. into darker, nocturnal terrain. Led by the pulsating tension of Six Shot Morning and Marianne, the record seamlessly fuses driving drum machines, ethereal synthesizers, and Grian Chatten's sharp poetic bite.
